_meta.project: AI-Based Compliance Auditor for Digital Lending Applications Under RBI Regulations

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
sources.note: RBI's website shows this document with a 'Withdrawn' marking; no specific superseding digital-lending document was independently identified. Used as primary source with this limitation disclosed.

sources.title: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans & Advances
sources.note: Incorporated by reference in the 2025 Directions, Para 4(i) and Para 8(i). Applicable to retail/MSME term loans sanctioned on or after 2024-10-01; credit card receivables exempt.

sources.title: Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts
sources.note: Incorporated by reference in the 2025 Directions, Para 8(ii). Effective 2024-01-01 for fresh/renewed loans. Exempt: Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations - skip DL-02 rules for these loan types.

_meta.scope_note: These three documents are the primary regulatory sources selected for this project's borrower-facing, technically verifiable compliance checks - not a claim of the complete regulatory framework governing digital lenders.

automation_levels.automatable: Can be checked directly from document text or app data
automation_levels.partially_automatable: Requires additional input beyond the base document/app (e.g. email records, in-app inspection)
automation_levels.not_automatable: Cannot be verified from external/public evidence alone; document as a limitation

changelog: v2: Reworded DL-01o from absolute violation to conditional-on-missing-consent-evidence, matching Para 8's actual wording
v2: Split unique proposal number into DL-01c2 (was previously missing entirely)
v2: Added DL-01p for KFS summary-box-in-loan-agreement cross-check (Para 9, previously missing)
v2: Added clarifying notes to DL-11 and DL-18 that Android permission strings are an implementation-level mapping, not verbatim RBI text

document_rules.requirement: KFS follows the standardised Annex A template, in a language the borrower understands, contents explained, acknowledgment of understanding obtained
document_rules.notes: Acknowledgment step not verifiable from the document alone

document_rules.requirement: Applicability scope check: retail/MSME term loan sanctioned on or after 2024-10-01 (credit cards exempt)
document_rules.notes: Used to decide whether KFS rules apply at all, not a pass/fail itself

document_rules.requirement: KFS validity period stated: >=3 working days (tenor >=7 days) or >=1 working day (tenor <7 days)
KFS carries a unique proposal number
document_rules.notes: Previously missing; distinct field from the validity period in DL-01c though sourced from the same paragraph

document_rules.requirement: Loan proposal/account number and type of loan present
Sanctioned loan amount present
Disbursal schedule present (staged or 100% upfront); if staged, references the specific agreement clause
Loan term present (years/months/days)
Instalment details present: type, number of EPIs, EPI amount, commencement date
Interest rate (%) and type (fixed/floating/hybrid) present
If floating rate: benchmark, benchmark rate, spread, final rate, reset periodicity, and impact of 25bps change disclosed
Fee/charges table present, split into payable-to-RE vs payable-to-third-party, each as one-time/recurring with amount or %
APR (%) present as a single computed figure
document_rules.future_enhancement: Math verification: recompute APR from principal+rate+fees using IRR method (Annex B worked example: Rs 20,000 @15% fixed -> 17.07% APR) and compare to stated value

document_rules.requirement: Contingent charges table present: penal charges, foreclosure charges, fixed<->floating switch charges

Part 2 qualitative fields present: recovery agent clause ref, grievance mechanism clause ref, grievance officer phone+email, transfer/securitisation disclosure, co-lending detail if applicable, cooling-off period + LSP recovery-agent detail for digital loans

Any fee/charge appearing in the loan agreement but NOT listed in the KFS fee table is flagged as a potential violation unless separate evidence of fresh explicit borrower consent for that specific fee is provided
document_rules.notes: Reworded from v1: Para 8 permits an undisclosed fee IF explicit consent is separately obtained, so this is a conditional flag, not an absolute violation. Compare KFS fee list against full loan agreement text; downgrade to 'unclear' rather than 'fail' if no consent evidence is available to check either way.

document_rules.requirement: The KFS is included as a summary box exhibited as part of the loan agreement itself, not only issued as a separate standalone document
document_rules.notes: Previously missing. Distinct from DL-01a (KFS format) - this checks that the loan agreement document contains an embedded KFS-equivalent summary box, not just that a KFS was separately provided.

document_rules.requirement: Charge is labeled/structured as 'penal charges' (flat or event-based fee) - NOT as 'penal interest' added to the interest rate
document_rules.notes: Wording-sensitive; requires LLM semantic check, not keyword search
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: No capitalisation - penal charges must not themselves accrue further interest
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: No additional component silently folded into the interest rate to disguise a penalty
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: RE has a Board-approved policy on penal charges
document_rules.notes: Cannot be verified from a single KFS/loan document; document as limitation
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: Quantum of penal charge is reasonable/commensurate with the non-compliance and non-discriminatory within the loan/product category
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: For individual (non-business) borrowers, penal charges do not exceed what non-individual/business borrowers are charged for the same non-compliance
document_rules.notes: Requires comparison data not present in a single document
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: Quantum and reason for penal charges appear in ALL of: loan agreement, KFS/MITC, and RE website 'Interest rates and Service Charges' page
document_rules.notes: MVP: check KFS presence only; Phase 2: compare KFS figure against loan agreement figure for consistency
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: Non-compliance reminders to borrower include the applicable penal charge
document_rules.notes: Requires access to actual reminder communications, not the loan document
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: Actual levy of penal charge plus specific reason separately communicated to borrower
document_rules.notes: Requires access to actual levy communications
document_rules.scope_exemption: Skip for Credit Cards, ECBs, Trade Credits, Structured Obligations

document_rules.requirement: Digitally signed KFS, loan summary, sanction letter, T&C, account statements, and RE/LSP privacy policy auto-delivered via registered email/SMS on execution
document_rules.notes: Checkable if borrower uploads the email/SMS record, not from KFS alone

document_rules.requirement: Grievance redressal officer's contact details (phone + email) present in the KFS
Recovery agent's particulars communicated via email/SMS before first contact
Cooling-off period disclosed - borrower can exit paying only principal + proportionate APR, no penalty, minimum 1 day
One-time processing fee for cooling-off exit (if any) disclosed upfront in KFS
Loan disbursed directly to borrower's bank account - never to LSP or third-party account
document_rules.notes: Check what agreement text STATES, not actual bank behavior

document_rules.requirement: No pass-through/pool account used for servicing or repayment
LSP fees paid directly by RE - never charged to or collected from the borrower

app_rules.requirement: DLA must not access contact list, call logs, file/media, or telephony functions
app_rules.notes: Core rule - pure code check, no AI needed. The banned_permissions list is our team's Android-manifest mapping of RBI's plain-language wording ('file and media, contact list, call logs, telephony functions'), not verbatim regulatory text - cite Para 12(i) itself in any report, not this permission-string list, as the regulatory source.

app_rules.requirement: Camera/microphone/location access allowed only as one-time, for KYC/onboarding, with explicit consent
app_rules.notes: Flag presence; one-time vs persistent not always visible from manifest alone

app_rules.requirement: Borrower gets granular consent controls: give/deny per data type, restrict third-party sharing, set retention, revoke, request deletion
Purpose of consent disclosed at each interface stage
app_rules.notes: Requires in-app inspection; out of scope for MVP, document as limitation

app_rules.requirement: Explicit consent required before sharing personal data with any third party (except statutory requirement)
LSP must not store personal data beyond basic minimum (name, address, contact)
Data storage policy (type, retention period, destruction protocol, breach handling) disclosed on website/DLA
No biometric data stored/collected unless a statutory exception applies
app_rules.notes: As with DL-11, this permission mapping is our implementation-level translation of Para 13(iii)'s plain-language prohibition, not verbatim RBI text.

app_rules.requirement: Data stored only on India-based servers; if processed abroad, deleted and returned within 24 hours
Comprehensive privacy policy publicly available on RE and LSP website
Any third party permitted to collect data via the DLA is disclosed in the privacy policy
App appears on RBI's CIMS-published Digital Lending App directory
app_rules.notes: Fully automatable, independent red flag; RE required to report all DLAs by 2025-06-15
